title: Robust Text Line Detection in Historical Documents: Learning and Evaluation Methods
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of text line detection and segmentation in historical documents. Although some of the documents used in the datasets (e.g., the Horae dataset from books of hours) may be religious in nature, the paper's evaluation methods and analysis do not engage with, benchmark, or analyze the religious, moral, or ethical content of these texts. The evaluation is strictly based on computer vision and text recognition performance metrics.
